name: Android box
description: Open chosen apps on an Android box (NVIDIA Shield, ...) over ADB instead of on the TV.
about: Opens chosen apps on an Android box such as an NVIDIA Shield over ADB instead of on the TV: pressing the app on Home switches the TV to the box's HDMI input and starts the app there. Set up from the manager (Features > Android box). It also gives the voice assistant and AI agents one tool, androidbox (status, the apps that open on the box, a connection test, choosing an app).
